name: Gray
premise: gray-x in its own voice: hold-music telepathy (genome winners + evolve winner, verbatim)
authorship: evolve harness 2026-10-19 overnight run (gate-passed, UNJUDGED — do not mistake for funny)

bits.text: Court of faces is just HR with lighting. Gray Face handles your complaint, White Face does the appeal, and both of them are thinking about lunch. I got a settlement offer from a guy whose eyes never blinked once. He slid the paper across the table like he was passing a note in fourth grade. I signed it. What am I going to do, argue with a mask?

I called the bank about a twelve-dollar fee and I swear I could hear the rep thinking, but it's one-sided, so all I get is his half. It was just hold music with his opinions layered over it. This guy's balance is a rounding error. The fee was legitimate. That's what killed me.

The hold music knows what I did. It's one-sided telepathy, they're broadcasting, I'm just sitting here holding my Social Security number like a bingo card. They play that flute loop until you confess. I called about a forty dollar charge and by the third chorus I'd admitted things my wife still doesn't know. The rep picked up and I just said sorry before she could even ask.

Everybody thinks one-sided telepathy would be spooky. It's not, it's customer service. I hear my neighbor's whole inner monologue and it's just hold music and grocery lists. Yesterday he was thinking "did I get enough Rotel" for forty-five minutes. That's it. That's the mind-reading. You don't learn anyone's secrets, you just learn they're low on Rotel.

The hold music at the pharmacy knows what I did. It's not a tune, it's a interrogation technique — three notes, then silence, like it's waiting for me to confess. And the worst part is I can feel the thoughts coming through one way, all of them about my cholesterol, and none of them mine.
